actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_note.description: Retrieve a single meeting note by its ID, with optional transcript.
actions.get_note.props.include_transcrip: Include the full meeting transcript in the response. The transcript shows who said what and when.
actions.get_note.props.note_id.descripti: The ID of the note to retrieve. Starts with `not_` followed by 14 characters (e.g. `not_1d3tmYTlCICgjy`). You can get this from the **List Notes** action.
actions.list_notes.description: List your meeting notes with optional date filters.
actions.list_notes.props.created_after.d: Only return notes created after this date. Leave empty to return all notes.
Only return notes created before this date. Leave empty for no upper limit.
actions.list_notes.props.page_size.descr: Number of notes to return per page (1–30).
actions.list_notes.props.updated_after.d: Only return notes updated after this date. Useful to find recently modified notes.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open the **Granola desktop app**.
2. Go to **Settings > API**.
3. Click **Create API Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it here.

**Note:** You need a Business or Enterprise plan to use API keys.
description: AI-powered meeting notes — automatically captures and summarizes your meetings.
triggers.new_note.description: Triggers when a new meeting note is created in Granola.
triggers.updated_note.description: Triggers when an existing meeting note is updated in Granola (e.g. summary edited, attendees changed).
